title: Affine sheaf derivations are determined on global sections
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] with $X$ affine [def-weil-affine-spectrum], and let $\mathcal F$ be any sheaf of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For $i=1,2$, let $D_i:\mathcal O_X\to\mathcal F$ be a morphism of sheaves of abelian groups satisfying $D_i(ab)=aD_i(b)+bD_i(a)$ on every open of $X$ and $D_i(f^\sharp(r)|_W)=0$ for every open $V\subseteq S$, $r\in\mathcal O_S(V)$, and $W\subseteq f^{-1}(V)$. If $D_{1,X}(a)=D_{2,X}(a)$ for every $a\in\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X)$, then $D_1=D_2$ as morphisms of sheaves. No quasi-coherence of $\mathcal F$ is required.
